input_ref: explore-fresh | Member: What will my doctor visit cost?

output.reason: None of the approved units gives the cost of a doctor visit. U-BEN-COST-001-02 is a disclaimer about cost estimates and contains no actual cost. U-BEN-COST-001-05 covers the referral requirement for HMO specialist visits. U-RX-EDU-001-05 covers caregiver authorization for drug information. None of them answers the question.
